verdict.rationale: Feitian publishes a first-party guide for using its FIDO security keys with OpenSSH to reach GitHub and Linux servers, which delivers hardware-backed SSH keys via the FIDO2 sk-ssh route. The keys also offer PIV functions managed through SK Manager, but the evidence only ties PIV to smart-card logon and digital signatures, not SSH. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that each SSH use requires a physical touch, PIV-based SSH evidence, any OpenPGP support, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond a one-line doc summary.
